messages:
Elaine: quick recap from today's session — objective: gated replay + 3 social clips + embargoed benchmark PDF. Need owners: captions (multi-geo), clip trims, HubSpot tagging/routing, legal sign-off. who takes what?
Mike: I can own HubSpot mapping + email send. propose lead scoring: watch% >50 -> add 'mql_webinar'; demo CTA click -> add 'hot_demo' and ping #sales.
Sanjay: grabbing Zoom raw now. deploy-bot says file uploaded. Ill generate SRTs and pull clips.
deploy-bot: Recording uploaded: gs://redwood-webinars/2026-03-20/rt-embeddings/recording.mp4 (1.9GB)
Elaine: clip plan: 2m demo highlight, 45s benchmark headline, 30s CTA push. Sanjay can you export MP4s + thumbnails and provide timecodes?
Sanjay: yep. ffmpeg snippet Im using: `ffmpeg -ss 00:23:40 -i recording.mp4 -t 00:00:45 -c copy clip-benchmark-45s.mp4`. Will push clips + manifest to gs://redwood-webinars/2026-03-20/clips/
Zoe: legal note: EU registrants require explicit consent on the replay form mentioning data processing and marketing contact. Also benchmark PDF is embargoed until I sign off and speakers approve. do not publish PDF link yet.
Mike: holding benchmark asset in email until Zoe clears. Email A/B subjects: A) "Watch: Real-time embeddings in production" B) "New benchmark: lower latency, same quality" send high-engagers first.
Elaine: tagging/UTM plan: include `region` so SDR routing works. HubSpot tags: webinar_replay, rt-embeddings, region-eu etc. Mike add exact tag names in the Zap.
Sanjay: captions plan: auto SRT, QC pass for en-us/en-uk. translations (es/fr/de) need vendor — timeline +48h.
Zoe: speaker name spellings + consent forms Ill finish review by 08:00 PT.
Mike: HubSpot mapping note: capture utm_source, utm_campaign, webinar_id, demo_clicked boolean. Zap flow: HS form -> add hs_tags -> webhook to routing lambda -> assign owner.
Sanjay: player emits play_progress events with percentage. Ill forward watch_pct to Zap lambda so HS contact gets play_pct property.
Elaine: timeline: clips + SRTs by 10:30am PT, HubSpot mapping + email draft by 11:00am PT, legal by 8:00am PT. Publish replay after legal sign-off. react with :thumbsup: when you accept task.
Mike: :thumbsup: on HubSpot/email.
Sanjay: :thumbsup: starting exports now.
Zoe: :thumbsup: will reply if any redlines.
Elaine: thanks Ill update Asana and post publish announcement in #marketing when live.
